health.app: Life Portal reads your health data — including activity goals, time in daylight, and overnight wrist temperature — to display metrics and sync with your server.
health.watch: Life Portal reads your health data — including activity goals, time in daylight, and overnight wrist temperature — to sync with your server.

locationWhenInUse.app: Life Portal needs your location to track and display your movement history.
locationWhenInUse.watch: Life Portal needs your location to display your current position.

locationAlways.app: Life Portal needs continuous location access to track your movements in the background.

motion.app: LifePortal uses motion data to detect when you arrive at and leave places, improving visit tracking accuracy.
